title: Embedded partner tile preflight + telemetry spec
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a pragmatic preflight and minimal spec for launching an embedded partner tile (marketplace listing tile) plus the telemetry events we must capture to measure adoption and health. Focus: operational gating, billing/entitlement mapping, copy variants, accessibility and localization, and telemetry for observability.

Scope:
- Public marketplace tile + partner landing flow (hosted listing)
- SKU mapping for metered usage and trial enablement
- Tile assets, copy and CTA variants (EN + initial i18n locales)
- Telemetry schema for frontend + backend events required for rollout metrics
- Acceptance checklist for sign-off before publish

Owner / Contact:
- Primary: Priya Desai (go-to-market)
- Product eng contact: Morgan Lee (marketplace integrations)
- Partner lead: Diego Alvarez

Timeline & rollout notes (rough):
- 2025-11-10: creative + copy freeze (v1)
- 2025-11-17: staging tile up, telemetry test harness connected
- 2025-11-24: internal canary (10% traffic) + partner review
- 2025-12-01: broad publish if no regressions

Acceptance criteria (must all pass):
- [ ] Listing tile renders in both Chrome and Safari mobile widths without layout shift > 0.1 CLS
- [ ] Thumbnails match spec (see assets) and load under 300ms from CDN edge
- [ ] CTA click leads to correct entitlement flow and billing SKU is provisioned in test account
- [ ] Telemetry events for view/click/cta-result are received and show expected properties in staging analytics pipeline
- [ ] Localization: EN copy present; FR/DE/JA placeholders validated in UI (fallback behavior verified)
- [ ] Accessibility: tile passes automated a11y scan and keyboard navigation tested end-to-end
- [ ] Legal: TOS snippet present, data residency callout if partner requests region restriction

Tile copy draft (short form, for A/B):
- Hero title variants (short):
  - "Deploy fast, serve cheaper — Redwood Dedicated for partners"
  - "High-throughput LLM inference for your product"
  - "Bring your model to production — managed inference"

- 1-line descriptor (variants):
  - "Reserved GPU capacity, SLA-backed latency, and secure private deployments."
  - "Predictable throughput and cost controls for production LLMs."

- CTAs (choose one per test):
  - Primary: "Start trial"
  - Secondary: "Request partner demo"
  - Tertiary (low friction): "See pricing"

- Microcopy (billing/entitlement visible on hover):
  - "Includes 30-day trial credit. Billing per-token after trial; reserved commit required for Dedicated."

Thumbnail & asset specs (for creative):
- Format: PNG or WebP; 1200x675 px hero image; 600x400 px tile thumbnail (lossless-ish, under 80KB)
- Alt text: concise descriptive alt, e.g., "Redwood Dedicated — GPU pools + autoscale"
- Color contrast: CTA buttons must meet 4.5:1 ratio against background

Billing / entitlement mapping (ops):
- SKU placeholder: REDWD-DEDICATED-TRIAL-30D (test SKU)
- Live SKU mapping: product-led SKU + enterprise reserved SKU (finalized in billing matrix)
- On CTA click: call /entitlement/assign with partner_id and sku_id; on success, redirect to partner-config flow
- Failure modes: if entitlement API 500s, show fallback CTA: "Contact sales" and fire telemetry event cta_result: 'entitlement_error'

Telemetry spec (minimal set) — names + required properties:
1) marketplace_tile_viewed (page/frontend)
   - properties: {tile_id, partner_id, user_id (hashed), locale, referrer, variant_id}
2) marketplace_tile_clicked (frontend)
   - properties: {tile_id, partner_id, user_id (hashed), click_target, variant_id}
3) marketplace_cta_initiated (frontend -> backend)
   - properties: {tile_id, partner_id, user_id (hashed), cta, timestamp, session_id}
4) entitlement_assign_attempted (backend)
   - properties: {request_id, partner_id, sku_id, user_id (hashed), outcome: success|failure, error_code}
5) entitlement_assign_result (backend)
   - properties: {request_id, partner_id, sku_id, outcome, latency_ms}
6) marketplace_onboarding_completed (backend)
   - properties: {partner_id, success: true|false, onboarding_time_seconds, user_count}
7) marketplace_tile_engagement_score (derived pipeline metric)
   - properties: {tile_id, partner_id, views_last_7d, clicks_last_7d, conversion_rate}

Telemetry notes:
- user_id must be hashed at frontend before sending (sha256) to preserve PII policy
- events should be emitted to the standard analytics topic with schema version v1.2
- include variant_id for A/B attribution (format: tile-{shortid}-v{int})
- staging pipeline must validate schema and drop any events missing required props

Localization and i18n plan:
- Initial locales: EN, FR, DE, JP
- Provide copy tokens for title, descriptor, CTA, microcopy; use i18n keys rather than full text in tile payload
- Fallback: use EN if translation missing and fire telemetry_locale_fallback event

Accessibility checklist (manual + automated):
- semantic HTML: tile uses <button> for CTAs, images have alt text
- keyboard focus order tested in staging (tab flow)
- color contrast automated test + manual screen reader walkthrough

Operational runbook (post-publish):
- Monitor telemetry for 24h: look for expected view->click conversion; alert if conversion drop >50% vs baseline
- If entitlement_assign failure rate > 1% over 30m, rollback to previous tile (or disable CTAs) and open incident JIRA-STOP-TILE
- Weekly snapshot: tile_engagement_score, onboarding completions, billing SKU activations

Partner review checklist (deliver to partner for signoff):
- [ ] Creative assets (thumbnail + alt text) approved
- [ ] Copy and CTAs approved for target locales
- [ ] Billing/SKU mapping verified and partner account test access provided
- [ ] PRICING page link verified & legal blurb reviewed

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm final live SKU names with finance (assigned to Ava Kim)
- Decide whether trial should auto-convert to pay-as-you-go or require manual commit (product decision)
- Confirm expected SLA language for public tile versus partner-only listing

Notes-to-self/loosely formatted brainstorm fragments:
- Could we show live latency sample (p99) on tile? probably too heavy, surface as "avg latency" but needs backend feed
- Consider small animated GIF for hero to show "autoscale in action" but need to check performance impact

Related artifacts and references:
- Confluence plan: CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM/marketplace/tiles-acceptance-9876 (detailed acceptance criteria)
- Infra ticket: JIRA-6789 (telemetry pipeline onboarding)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-tiles/pull/221

Next steps (immediate):
1) finalize v1 copy and select CTAs by 2025-11-07 (owner: Priya)
2) ops to create test SKU and provide test credentials (owner: Ava)
3) eng to wire telemetry events to staging and confirm schema validation (owner: Morgan)

If anything blocks sign-off, escalate in #partner-listings Slack and tag eng-product oncall.
